smoke.description: Fast structural smoke test. Uses only 4 subjects per condition, K=5, 20 fit iterations, and 2 decoding repetitions. This is NOT expected to reproduce paper numbers exactly; it verifies the pipeline end-to-end.

mini-paper.description: Small exact-replication profile. Uses all subjects and original fit/decoding settings, but only a handful of K values. K=5 tests all four fit families; K=46 additionally exercises the representative spatial across-condition model used for interpretation.

full.description: Observed full model-order grids from the original repository inventory. Uses the original 200 fit iterations and 20 decoding repetitions.
